# Sable Orchard Business Bank — v24 evaluation package

Builder input: ONLY the numbered documents 01-specification.md, in numeric order, together with openapi.json. All other files are evaluation material; do not send them to the builder. Fictional bank; the API uses a .example.invalid endpoint.

Shape: one clean numbered bank specification. Two products maximum.

expected.json uses the same checks/projections as synthetic/clean-eom-expected.json, including ordered identity requirements and attempts, outcome tables and named special cases, plus v24 floor_rules, past_deadline and opening-verbatim checks. expected-api.json separately records field mappings and request enums. rule-probes.json covers next-month fifteenth, next-month business month-end, both branches of whichever-comes-first, year rollover, expired current-month windows, minimum boundaries and full-balance caps. Dates are computed by bankcal; floor values are exact Decimal strings.

Source review: v24 supports day_of_month with month_offset, earliest composition, percent/max_of floors and past_deadline=no_promise. The bank documents deliberately state these rules in ordinary prose. The expired rule is per product: other products and special-case/transfer handling retain their normal precedence. The deadline date itself is still eligible.

Precision limitation: the runtime uses binary floating-point arithmetic; percent uses Python round and max_of up_cent uses a tolerance. This does not guarantee an arbitrary-precision financial rounding contract for extreme amounts or every decimal tie. These packages use ordinary positive whole-cent balances; 20% has no exact half-cent ties on that domain, and supplied greater-of probes use normal amounts. Exact Decimal probe values are the bank arithmetic oracle, not proof of all possible float inputs. Zero/negative balances and missing required base fields are outside the specified API contract. Enormous numerical values are not covered by these probes; this is a coverage limit, not permission to change the bank arithmetic. Any discrepancy between exact bank rounding and runtime output is an implementation defect. No discrepancy was found on the supplied probes.

Offline verification: seven POST operations parsed; every request/response schema checked with jsonschema Draft4; pure production floor helper checked against every Decimal probe (including upward half-cent ties), with no workflow execution; authored oracle reconstructed in memory and passed PolicyIR normalization and policy.validate against API enums; all projection checks matched. No extraction, build, live API, simulation, workflow publication or generated output directory was used. README and expected files are never builder input.
